b16fe85e.text:
My Journal

The terror of these past few weeks is almost more than I can bear; why is it that by writing words into this book I can somehow keep the madness at bay?  Perhaps it is as if I'm confessing my sins to a silent companion, or freeing my mind of these tortured thoughts and confining them to paper.  

I began a journal before this one, but it remains in a place to which I cannot return.  So I will start afresh.  But this time, I will start from the true beginning.
b16fe85e.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

db53ee24.text:
Master Carevin,

The bearer of this note has shown himself to be upstanding in the Light, capable of battling the undead and demons that plague the borders of Duskwood, and willing to join the Carevin family in their cause of Light.

I would thereby suggest that you give this warrior of the Light further duties--perhaps to investigate some of the townsfolk that are under suspicion of succor to the enemies of the Light.

Yours faithfully,
Calor
db53ee24.title: Calor's Note

e772d22d.text:
Morgan Ladimore was a great and noble knight who fought in defense of the innocent, the poor, and the afflicted. For many years, he worked diligently throughout the outlying areas of Azeroth, bringing relief to the suffering and swift justice to evildoers.

He was married to a young girl named Lys in the summer of his eighteenth year. They were much in love with each other and would eventually produce three children, a son and two daughters.

Morgan was thirty-two when war broke out in
e772d22d.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

10276|2846a7fb.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|2846a7fb.text: A fast learner is what ye are, and a good smith to boot. I would sign off on yer work any day of the week. But I sense ye still have some learnin in ye. Go talk to Bengus Deepforge, he's a hard taskmaster but he's also one of the best.

10277|de38fa19.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|de38fa19.text: Ye know more than I do, that's a certainty. Tell ye what though, go talk with me da'. He'll want ye ta prove yerself, but he is a fine teacher indeed. His name's Rotgath, and ye'll find him near the anvils workin steel for ol' Bengus.

1077|75241b9c.name: Prospector Whelgar
1077|75241b9c.text: Oh my, this is quite historical.  A monumental find.  But these wretched beasts!  Merrin seems to be handling the situation quite well.  Now if I could just piece together this complicated puzzle. . . .

1239|c86281a7.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
1239|c86281a7.text: If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1244|e492be56.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|e492be56.text:
<Rethiel takes the Rotheap Innards from you.>

It is worse than I thought. The dark presence deep beneath us seethes with a malevolence that has seeped into the very fibers of life within the wetlands.

For now, I fear all we can do is combat its symptoms. Provide relief to the land and those who rely on it where we can.

Meanwhile, we must continue to look for the source. It roils... whispers just under the veil of the sounds of night.

Take this, as a token of my gratitude. May it help you further combat this madness.

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1464|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1480|4d61ac25.name: Caitlin Grassman
1480|4d61ac25.text: Alchemy can help so many people! It's my life's passion.

15351|f54c92d6.name: Alliance Brigadier General
15351|f54c92d6.text: The war against the Horde has reached full tilt, $N.  This is a time of great need for the Alliance and it's quite necessary that all of us do our part to help.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

2277|985afd1f.name: Loremaster Dibbs
2277|985afd1f.text: Hello, $N! What can I do for you?

2367|c2467ddc.name: Donald Rabonne
2367|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2432|c5ceacbe.name: Darla Harris
2432|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2455|2237a3b1.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

247264|a8fa316f.name: Emissary Jacques
247264|a8fa316f.text:
Hail and well met, traveler.

I wish my arrival was met with good tidings but the realm of Dalaran is in need of aid from the kingdoms of the Alliance.

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256391|3090047f.name: Elaine Compton
256391|3090047f.text:
Oh goodness, you snuck up on me! Glad to see you, $N, the Azeroth Commerce Authority is always in need of new contractors.

If you are the sort to enjoy a stroll through the forest gathering useful materials or possess the skills to craft something from scratch, well, you have found yourself right at home!

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256729|06bc17cb.name: Nina Surefire
256729|06bc17cb.text:
I know what you're thinking, but don't worry, we keep our cooking and alchemy ingredients separate!

How can I help you?

256730|fb965f91.name: Stondry Darkhammer
256730|fb965f91.text: The ingots are for display only!

256733|8265ab1b.name: Fritz Fizzle
256733|8265ab1b.text: Pleased to meet you! If you like to tinker, you have come to the right place!

264|b3b21323.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
264|b3b21323.text: At ease, $C.  If you are just passing though I suggest you stick to the roads and only travel by day. If your business is here in Darkshire, consider lending your abilities to The Night Watch.  Our skill is unquestionable but our numbers are small.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

268047|b840f12c.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|b840f12c.text: $C, come help out at Darkspear Islands against the Darkspear Raiders. We really could use more troops out there.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

269127|1e33d6fe.name: Image of Archmage Modera
269127|1e33d6fe.text:
If you've tried to enter Dalaran, you've likely met with the Kirin Tor guards. They are under strict orders not to let outsiders into the city while this disruption runs rampant. The council has decreed that keeping up appearances is more important than preventing a catastrophe.

I suffer no such delusions.

2700|0efca734.name: Captain Nials
2700|0efca734.text:
We at Refuge Pointe hold one of the few remaining patches of Stromgarde territory in the Arathi Highlands.  And we're losing ground...

If you have words for me, then I hope they are good tidings.

270581|e6b98502.name: Fyrenz Vishonar
270581|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

270637|3e0b4d08.name: Howin Kindfeather
270637|3e0b4d08.text: So many Wildhammer lives lost... whole families erased...

273|1299e7cb.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
273|1299e7cb.text: Keep the door closed, $C.  Never know when the Dark Riders will be passing through again.

276170|e50e47b5.name: Belanaa Windveil
276170|e50e47b5.text: I am Belanaa Windveil and I am an agent of the High Order here on Azeroth. If you'd like to make a donation of cloth to our organization, we would be most grateful.

276316|1b05d5c3.name: Raul Sweete
276316|1b05d5c3.text:
If ye want to see the elven port of Auberdine and all its mysterious mist, you've come to the right dock. If ye also want to see the beauty and glory of Menethil Harbor, even better--same ship'll take ye there, too!

It ain't a journey for the weak, but if you've got the spirit of adventure in yer gullet then yer in luck!

2835|c5ceacbe.name: Cedrik Prose
2835|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3136|b873f90f.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|b873f90f.text: Now I'm the one who feels rough around the edges, I honestly don't think there's anything left I can teach you. But you know who can? Bengus Deepforge in Ironforge, now there's a dwarf that knows his steel. Go look him up in The Great Forge of Ironforge, see if he's up to having a new trainee under him.

3518|ed056522.name: Thomas Miller
3518|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

4258|965533ff.name: Bengus Deepforge
4258|965533ff.text: Welcome to the Great Forge lad. It may be cold outside but we keep it nice and hot down 'ere. Grab a hammer, strike that anvil and show me ye've got what it takes to be a Blacksmith of the Great Forge!

4963|23ff2c7e.name: Mikhail
4963|23ff2c7e.text: Give me a couple minutes, $N. There was some excitement in here a moment ago, and I just want to make sure things have died back down. I'll talk to you soon enough.

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

5491|837f02f9.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5502|fb513610.name: Shylamiir
5502|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

5511|cbb91364.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|cbb91364.text: I said ye had the blood of a blacksmith in ye, and I was right. Go to Ironforge, to The Great Forge, and find yerself a Dwarven smith by the name of Bengus Deepforge. My teacher, and one of the greatest smiths I've ever known.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5566|fb513610.name: Tannysa
5566|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

6569|58cd03a1.name: Gnoarn
6569|58cd03a1.text:
Where Troggs and Leper Gnomes roam stands our home - Gnomeregan.

Our families lost, our homes displaced. Scattered.

Oh how I long for the days of carefree Gnomeregan life, but those days are no more. We must make our stand! We must save Gnomeregan!

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

7937|51417c16.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937|51417c16.text: Hello there, $c. I am High Tinker Mekkatorque of the exiles of Gnomeregan.

7944|9a62fac1.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
7944|9a62fac1.text:
I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!

Also, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...

9099|738476a6.name: Sraaz
9099|738476a6.text: Having a bad day? Try some cherry pie.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

957|a7a421b8.name: Dane Lindgren
957|a7a421b8.text: A far better blacksmith than I am, that's for sure. Though I'll deny it if you tell anyone I said that. You should go speak with Therum Deepforge. If anyone can teach you more, it's him.

101-progress.name: Madame Eva
101-progress.text: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-progress.title: The Totem of Infliction

1241-progress.name: Jorgen
1241-progress.text: Hmph, you better have good reason to interrupt a man and his fishin'. I don't take kindly to peddlers, let alone beggars.
1241-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1242-progress.name: Elling Trias
1242-progress.text: Hello, $N. Is there something I can do for you? Perhaps you'd like to try some of our special Trias cheddar? Or a block of Darnassian bleu?
1242-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1243-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1243-progress.text:
Not too safe to be traveling about in the woods, $N. Be careful, and if you see anything suspicious or dangerous, contact the Watchers immediately. Don't try and take anything on yourself. We're not responsible for anything terrible that might happen to you.

But we both know you're gonna ignore me and fight whatever comes out of the darkness anyway, don't we? Haha, yeah, you adventurer types... all the same.
1243-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1244-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1244-progress.text: Be careful out there, $N. I know Trias was the one to send you here, but that doesn't mean there isn't anything lurking out in the woods that couldn't cause you some trouble... especially with you investigating the Defias.
1244-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1245-progress.name: Elling Trias
1245-progress.text: I see you're back, and in one piece. We both know you're not here for cheese, so let's cut out the pleasantries. Was Backus any help, or have you even left for Duskwood yet?
1245-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

133-progress.name: Abercrombie
133-progress.text: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick!  Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?
133-progress.title: Ghoulish Effigy

134-progress.name: Abercrombie
134-progress.text: Do you have my crate?  If so, then please...give it to me quickly!
134-progress.title: Ogre Thieves

156-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-progress.text: Hi, $N.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
156-progress.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

157-progress.name: Abercrombie
157-progress.text: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
157-progress.title: Deliver the Thread

159-progress.name: Abercrombie
159-progress.text: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights.  Did you get it for me?
159-progress.title: Juice Delivery

160-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
160-progress.text:
Abercrombie...?  I don't know a person of that name.  You say you have a letter for me from this Abercrombie fellow?

Well let's have it then...
160-progress.title: Note to the Mayor

181-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
181-progress.text: Were you able to convince Zzarc'Vul to lend us his monocle for our experiment?
181-progress.title: Look to the Stars

223-progress.name: Jonathan Carevin
223-progress.text: Yes, what is it? Make it quick, I've pressing matters to attend to.
223-progress.title: Worgen in the Woods

228-progress.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
228-progress.text: I don't blame you if you're having trouble with him, $N. Some of our strongest Watchers have been lost to Mor'Ladim.
228-progress.title: Mor'Ladim

230-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
230-progress.text: You found what??  Please, let me see it...
230-progress.title: Sven's Camp

251-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
251-progress.text: A note from Abercrombie the hermit, eh?  I don't know him, though if he lives out at the graveyard then I do know his brains have rotted out!
251-progress.title: Translate Abercrombie's Note

252-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
252-progress.text: Ah, is the note translated?  Please, let me see it...
252-progress.title: Translation to Ello

253-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
253-progress.text: Have you yet found Eliza's grave?  Do you have the Embalmer's heart?
253-progress.title: Bride of the Embalmer

262-progress.name: Madame Eva
262-progress.text: If you have something that belongs to the shadowy figure for whom you seek, then let me see it.  I may be able to divine something of its owner.
262-progress.title: The Shadowy Figure

265-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
265-progress.text:
Sometimes I'll sell blank books to scholars and mages, or to anyone who wants to keep a journal.

I remember well everyone to whom I sold a book within the last few months...
265-progress.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

266-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-progress.text:
The Scarlet Raven doesn't see the business it used to, but we still do get travelers passing through.

If you can describe the person you're looking for, maybe I'll remember him.
266-progress.title: Inquire at the Inn

268-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
268-progress.text: Did you find who the Shadowy Figure was?
268-progress.title: Return to Sven

269-progress.name: Bishop Farthing
269-progress.text: Rest, brother.  I can tell you have traveled far, and you bear a heavy burden.  Can you tell me what casts that dark shadow over you?
269-progress.title: Seeking Wisdom

2746-progress.name: Tyrion
2746-progress.text:
I've been watching Lescovar for a couple weeks now. Trias has never trusted him, but we didn't suspect he was involved in anything to do with the Defias Brotherhood. We were following leads that tied him to the Twilight's Hammer. Either way, he's become more dangerous than this city can deal with, and that's where we come in.

Get me those items and we can put my plan into effect.
2746-progress.title: Items of Some Consequence

277-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-progress.text: Do you have the Gnolls' tools for fire?
277-progress.title: Fire Taboo

279-progress.name: Karl Boran
279-progress.text: Our merchants will not be safe until we are rid of Gobbler and those Murlocs.
279-progress.title: Claws from the Deep

288-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-progress.text: Oh, I'm so very thirsty! Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?
288-progress.title: The Third Fleet

289-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-progress.text: In my dreams, I can sometimes hear the doomed moans of my brethren! Please, good sir, free them from the bonds and quiet their cries.
289-progress.title: The Cursed Crew

296-progress.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-progress.text: Is Sarltooth dead? Have you redeemed the memory of the fallen?
296-progress.title: Ormer's Revenge

299-progress.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-progress.text: Have you uncovered the four fragments yet, $N?  Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru...
299-progress.title: Uncovering the Past

304-progress.name: Longbraid the Grim
304-progress.text: Were you able to locate Balgaras the Foul yet, $c?  He has been evading us for quite some time.
304-progress.title: A Grim Task

306-progress.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
306-progress.text: Were you able to find Merrin? Did she send word?
306-progress.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

322-progress.name: Grimand Elmore
322-progress.text: How might I ply my craft for you, $c?
322-progress.title: Blessed Arm

324-progress.name: Glorin Steelbrow
324-progress.text: Did you find the lightforge iron you need?
324-progress.title: The Lost Ingots

325-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
325-progress.text: Hello, $N.  You haven't been gone that long, but I see a fire in your eyes I did not see before.
325-progress.title: Armed and Ready

337-progress.name: Milton Sheaf
337-progress.text: Ooh!  What's that old book you have there?  Can I see it??
337-progress.title: An Old History Book

377-progress.name: Councilman Millstipe
377-progress.text: So long as a molester of the dead like Dextren Ward is permitted to live, justice stands betrayed.  Return to me once Lord Ebonlocke's sentence of death is carried out on that defiler, Ward.  We shall give the families of the dead the closure they deserve and better yet, we will send a clear message to the House of Nobles in Stormwind.
377-progress.title: Crime and Punishment

378-progress.name: Motley Garmason
378-progress.text: I won't let foolish $R bureaucracy interfere with Dwarven matters, $N.  Kam Deepfury is a proven conspirator in the Thandol Span attack.  King Magni's good people lost their lives because of Deepfury's deceit.  The Humans might be content to let Deepfury rot in The Stockade but I will not sleep soundly at night until Deepfury is slain.
378-progress.title: The Fury Runs Deep

386-progress.name: Guard Berton
386-progress.text: Have you been to Stormwind yet, to The Stockade?  I fear whatever trickery that has kept Targorr the Dread alive for this long will eventually bring about his freedom.  He was sentenced to die, $N, not act as some political pawn on a noble's whim.
386-progress.title: What Comes Around...

388-progress.name: Nikova Raskol
388-progress.text: I see you are back, $c.  Have you collected 10 Red Wool Bandanas from those Defias Scum in The Stockade yet?
388-progress.title: The Color of Blood

391-progress.name: Warden Thelwater
391-progress.text: Either you bring me Thredd's head, or I'll take yours, understand, $N?
391-progress.title: The Stockade Riots

393-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
393-progress.text: Greetings. Of what service can I be to you, $c?
393-progress.title: Shadow of the Past

396-progress.name: Lady Katrana Prestor
396-progress.text: $N, yes? I was informed by Baros Alexston that you would be coming. I must say, I am most interested in what you have to say.
396-progress.title: An Audience with the King

453-progress.name: Jitters
453-progress.text: Who are you??  Leave me be!
453-progress.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

464-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
464-progress.text: Have you attacked the Dragonmaw encampment?
464-progress.title: War Banners

469-progress.name: James Halloran
469-progress.text: Hello there, $c. Could I interest you in a pair of boots?  Perhaps some newly cured skins?
469-progress.title: Daily Delivery

471-progress.name: James Halloran
471-progress.text:
My apprentice is like a son to me. It's going to be hard for him to live his life with only one leg.

Ah, $N, how goes it?  Do you have my skins?
471-progress.title: Apprentice's Duties

484-progress.name: James Halloran
484-progress.text: $N, right? Do you have my skins?
484-progress.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

68-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
68-progress.text: Ah, I remember you.  You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow.  Did you ever find what you were looking for?
68-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

70-progress.name: Caretaker Folsom
70-progress.text: What have ya got there?  Let me take a look at that. . .
70-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

74-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
74-progress.text: What have you got there?  I cannot see.  My eyesight is very bad.  Put it in my hands.
74-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

75-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
75-progress.text: Did you find that page I mentioned, $N?
75-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

7793-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7793-progress.text:
As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low.  Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community!  If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7793-progress.title: A Donation of Silk

78-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
78-progress.text:
Marshal Haggard sent you?  Why didn't you say so? 

Ah, good ol' Haggard.  Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long.  Anyway, let me see what you've got there.
78-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

79-progress.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
79-progress.text: This better be good, $c.  Let me see what you have and tell me your tale.  But by the Light, be quick about it.  Darkshire's defense is my number one priority.  I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
79-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

80-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
80-progress.text: Back again, $N?  What do you have this time?
80-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

91905-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91905-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91905-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92432-accept.name: Emissary Jacques
92432-accept.text:
I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our ley lines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.

We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!

Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.
92432-accept.title: An Alarming Request

92432-complete.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92432-complete.text:
I see Jacques was successful in garnering aid.

While not strictly permitted, we cannot allow our pride to turn away allies in our desperate hour. Do not let the guards fool you. Things are anything but under control.
92432-complete.title: An Alarming Request

92456-accept.name: Shylamiir
92456-accept.text:
If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.
92456-accept.title: A Green Sample

92456-complete.name: Shylamiir
92456-complete.text:
This is... not what I had in mind.

Clearly the city is going through more than I expected. But what you found is just as fascinating, if not more so.

I guess you're not as troublesome as I thought. Good work.
92456-complete.title: A Green Sample

92456-progress.name: Shylamiir
92456-progress.text: Well? Do you have it yet?
92456-progress.title: A Green Sample

92457-accept.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92457-accept.text:
The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.

While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457-accept.title: Starving Arcane

92457-complete.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92457-complete.text: Thank you $N, this progress will help ensure Dalaran is safe.
92457-complete.title: Starving Arcane

92458-accept.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92458-accept.text:
Whatever disturbed the ley lines, it started at the top of the Violet Citadel. A thunderous crash rang out from the parlors above, and now we are overrun with rampant arcane power. It's taking all we have just to keep the wards in place.

We cannot afford to stall any longer. We need help.

The Kirin Tor are busy inside, but you will still need a less public approach to gain entry. Take this key and meet me in the citadel once you've made your way into the city. We must put an end to this disruption.
92458-accept.title: Heart of Disruption

92458-complete.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92458-complete.text:
I don't know what you saw up there, $N, but it does not matter. What matters now is containing this mote and putting an end to this madness.

You did your part well. Now the rest is up to us.
92458-complete.title: Heart of Disruption

92458-progress.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92458-progress.text: What good is our pride if there isn't a city left standing to be proud of?
92458-progress.title: Heart of Disruption

92459-accept.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92459-accept.text:
The council will not be happy to learn of our subterfuge, but they cannot deny results. The city is calming down, and we are free to lower our wards.

I think it's only fair you deliver the good word. Take this mote to Archmage Celindra within the Violet Citadel.
92459-accept.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor

92459-complete.name: Archmage Celindra
92459-complete.text:
Where did you find this? The parlor?

<Archmage Celindra's expression darkens momentarily before regaining her composure.>

I think it is best you dispel this from your thoughts, friend. For now, the Kirin Tor welcomes a competent $c such as yourself. Welcome to Dalaran.
92459-complete.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor

92459-progress.name: Archmage Celindra
92459-progress.text: Archmage Modera speaks highly of you. What brings you to Dalaran?
92459-progress.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor

92489-complete.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
92489-complete.text:
A creature of pure mana? Whatever is causing this disturbance is more powerful than initial reports suggested.

Your aid bought them precious time and reminded the Kirin Tor who their allies are. Good work, $N.
92489-complete.title: Power Overwhelming

95646-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-progress.text: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.
95646-progress.title: Horrors in the Highland

95795-accept.name: Unknown
95795-accept.text:
<You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
95795-accept.title: Fallen in the Fen

95809-accept.name: Unknown
95809-accept.text:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809-accept.title: Heartwoven

95809-progress.name: Caitlin Grassman
95809-progress.text: I'm more than worried about him!
95809-progress.title: Heartwoven

96138-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96138-complete.text:
Merrick Valor, you say? Poor boy always wanted to prove himself. It was a shame what happened to him and his family.

Thank you for bringing this, $N. Perhaps it can shed some additional light on Raven Hill's history.
96138-complete.title: Merrick's Bow

98072-progress.name: James Halloran
98072-progress.text: Ah, $N! Do you have those scales?
98072-progress.title: Crocs of the Sky

98189-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
98189-progress.text: What's that you've got there? Let me take a look.
98189-progress.title: Return the Statuette

98190-progress.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98190-progress.text: Let us speak, $c. I can feel you carry something of the Light.
98190-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-complete.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-complete.text:
By the Light... it looks just like his boy...

<Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker pauses for a moment.>

This statuette has indeed been blessed. Its connection to Terenas, its survival of what that monster did to him... this carries great power for those who believe in its strength.

It is best kept here for now, under guard of the $c order. We will meditate on it further to learn more of its gifts, and perhaps it may aid us in dark times ahead.

Thank you, $c. Light bless you.
98191-complete.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-progress.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-progress.text: Light be with you, $c. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?
98191-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98197-progress.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-progress.text: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
98197-progress.title: Spoils of War

98208-progress.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-progress.text: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.
98208-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98282-progress.name: Caitlin Grassman
98282-progress.text: Have you had any luck? I know it's a pain to ask, but I really do need a whole gland!
98282-progress.title: Alchemical Hazards

98463-accept.name: Barkeep Kelly
98463-accept.text:
Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.

The real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.

Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.

Nixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.
98463-accept.title: Talk of the Town

98815-progress.name: James Halloran
98815-progress.text: Welcome back, $c. Need any leather oil for your equipment?
98815-progress.title: Highland Hides

98824-progress.name: High Explorer Magellas
98824-progress.text: Have a look at our gallery, but please, don't touch the artifacts, unless it's one you're here to donate to the library.
98824-progress.title: Prehistoric Prism
